description.value: The Whistler Museum traces the resort town's evolution from wilderness to world-class mountain destination, covering early lodge operators, the birth of Whistler Blackcomb, and the 2010 Winter Olympics. Located in the heart of Whistler Village behind the Public Library and open by donation, it also maintains an archival database, a gift shop, and runs nature interpretation programs. It is a culturally rich stop for cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky corridor who want context for the landscape around them.
